reviews.summary: Then, now, next and three specific letters are usable this weekend, but one takeaway promised advice ('what you've given up, how lucky he is') the post never gives.

Every template and scheduling claim checks out, but two 'leave out' items restated how-to-write-a-love-letter, 'got past' and 'got the time wrong' were UK usage, and the Spanish had 'en breve', 'ha sido mucho', 'más de exactamente esto', 'acaban en pedir' and an odd 'media'.
The only result with a structure by years and three detailed letters, but the title didn't say there were example letters inside and no heading named the one-year letter, the biggest variant.

applied: Takeaway now matches the 'leave out' list (EN and ES).
'Promises you can't keep' replaced with an anniversary-specific item, 'The way things used to be'; the famous-quote item removed (both echoed the love-letter guide).
Title 'Anniversary letter to your boyfriend, with 3 example letters' / «…con 3 cartas de ejemplo».
Example headings name the years: 1-year, three years in, five years in (EN and ES).
Spanish: «en pocas palabras», «homenaje póstumo», «de extensión media», «ha pasado de todo», «esta noche hace cinco años», «más de esto, tal cual», «acaban pidiendo pizza».

Polish taken: a fill-in-the-blank version of the structure; a long-distance line for the next visit; «Los ex», «ochenta años», «más desenfadada»; FAQ length answer reworded away from the love-letter FAQ.
rejected: Exact word count '275' in the long-letter intro: 'close to three hundred' is accurate and reads better.
Softening the 'I don't say this enough' line in src/content/recipients.ts: outside the blog folders the routine may change.

reviews.summary: Round-1 changes landed; the structure, the fill-in version and three letters with honest lengths let her write it tonight.
Every claim and round-1 fix checks out, but the long letter's hospital waiting room was the blog's third, and the medium letter's 'for everyone, me included' echoed good-morning-messages-for-him.
The new title and year-named headings match page one's sample-letter intent and the 1-, 3- and 5-year searches without taking the queued ideas posts' searches.

applied: Long letter: the waiting room becomes a four-hour night drive after a cancelled flight, with a sandwich on the passenger seat (EN and ES).
Medium letter: 'from your sister's exam dates to the name of my boss's dog' in place of the echoing line (EN and ES).

Polish taken: hard-year FAQ sample reworded away from the birthday-card post; «de llegar», «se quede en», «relación a distancia»; '(Your name)' at the end of the fill-in version; 'on top of his phone' for the paper letter.
rejected: Month-by-month letters: the search reviewer advised against them so the queued 6-month and monthiversary posts keep their searches.

reviews.summary: Round-2 changes read naturally; a structure, a fill-in version and three letters whose lengths match their intros.
No reused sentences and every claim checks out, but the new night-drive line said 'fetch me' (UK), and the Spanish switched to the indefinido within 'este año' frames, which reads non-peninsular.
Title, year-named headings and the by-years table match page one's intent without taking the queued anniversary posts' searches.

applied: Spanish pretérito perfecto within 'este año': «has conducido», «has montado», «te has reído», «has llamado», «has sido tú quien se ha asegurado», «me has hecho sentir sola».
Polish taken: 'showed up' / 'showing up', «un billete» to match the Keepsake manifest, 'the move to the place with the noisy pipes' (EN and ES).

reviews.summary: Round-3 changes read naturally; a structure to fill in tonight, a version with blanks and three letters whose lengths match their intros.
Every claim matches the code, no sentence repeats another post, and the Spanish is natural Spain Spanish in her voice with the right tenses.
Title, year-named headings and the by-years table match page one's sample-letter intent while leaving the queued anniversary and long-distance posts their searches.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied: a write-it-the-night-before line (reader); 'coffee jar', «se abre con un toque y muestra una foto» and 'de la más corta a la más larga' in the ES description (editor).
